minimum_scoreability_rule.allowed_missing_cell_handling: Every missing cell must have a preregistered non-scoreable handling rule before launch; no post-hoc replacement after terminal outcomes are known.

not_allowed: claim the next design was chosen without seeing previous outcomes
count previous H_future outcomes as validation for a post-hoc redesigned release
treat H_future as the target profile

primary_rule.name: stratified_absolute_gap_ci
primary_rule.rule: For each preregistered repo or repo-family stratum, abs(B_eval_predicted_pass_rate - H_future_observed_pass_rate) <= 0.15.
primary_rule.success_condition: Every preregistered primary stratum meets the absolute gap threshold and all primary policy/scoreability gates pass.

secondary_diagnostics: MAE between B_eval-predicted and H_future observed pass rates
RMSE between B_eval-predicted and H_future observed pass rates
binomial negative log likelihood if enough strata exist
Brier score if enough strata exist
